answer_3.quote: The videos used in these datasets were often limited to just a few dozen seconds or minutes in length. Recent video benchmarks  have seen considerable improvements, both in the variety of evaluation tasks and the duration of the videos. Video-MME  has extended the evaluation video length to an hour, while also introducing twelve distinct evaluation tasks, including Temporal Reasoning and Information Synopsis.
